page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top, above a printed ornament. Then the division heading HOMILIA decimaquarta, two verse-reference headings (MATTH. 26. and MARC. 14.) and numbered verse paragraphs in the single column. The catchword "suis" stands at the lower right.

main_text.head: HOMILIA decimaquarta.
MATTH. 26.
main_text.p: 63. Et respondens Pontifex Maximus dixit ei, Adiuro te per Deum viventem ut dicas nobis an tu sis Christus ille Filius Dei.
64. Dicit ei Iesus, Tu dixisti: quin etiam dico vobis, Ab hoc tempore videbitis Filium hominis sedentem ad dextram potentiae Dei, & venientem in nubibus coeli.
65. Tunc Pontifex Maximus dirupit vestimenta sua, dicens, Blasphemauit: quid amplius egemus testibus? Ecce, nunc audistis blasphemiam eius. Quid vobis videtur?
66. Ipsi vero respondentes dixerunt, Teneur mortis poena.
main_text.head: MARC. 14.
main_text.p: 61. Rursum Pontifex Maximus eum interrogauit, & dixit ei, Tu-ne es ille Christus Filiusil-lius Benedicti?
62. Iesus autem dixit, Ego sum, & videbitis Filium hominis sedentem ad dextram potentiae Dei, & venientem cum nubibus coeli.
63. Pontifex Maximus vero diruptis vestibus suis

page.notes: Verse numbers 63, 64, 65, 66, 61, 62, 63 stand at the left of each verse as printed. The word "Teneur" is as printed and may be a misprint for "Tenetur". The line "Filiusil-lius" is as printed at a line end. Long s was read as s. The catchword "suis" at the lower right was read from the scan.
